title: chat-wss: presence rate limit can leave stale state
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md:291 drops ChatPresenceEvent above 1/30s per contact with no 'latest state SHOULD be delivered when window reopens' (cf. draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:269). Online then offline within 30s can leave the contact shown online indefinitely.
close_reason: Presence: latest state SHOULD be delivered when rate window reopens.
